title: Migrate observed transfer rows and LZ descriptors
changes: Extend the existing authenticated row and descriptor resources with three EUR transfer rows, three linked descriptors and three wrappers before existing LZ streams. Validate all row-to-descriptor and descriptor-to-stream links without changing guest indexing.
The 72 source bytes include 58 previously unowned bytes observed in the E172 scene sample; previous fields and 118 other resources are preserved.
validation: Source e182-transfer-source-g0ce9o5s; Wine original-reader trace e182-transfer-trace-wine-qu75rzi6; publication, twelve interpreter/native reader cases and poisoned mixed-owner boundaries e182-transfer-wine-fjrrnhsl.

Wine e182-transfer-scene-wine-fx2_p2kt matches complete state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio across 600 frames with the new backing and seven existing encoded LZ streams altered; all seven LZ blocks are used. Wine CLI e182-transfer-cli-wine-8dilrn0i creates, reuses and verifies 121 files.
limitations: Other scenes and consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. The E172 sample still contains 3,603 observed unowned bytes outside the accepted increments. No performance measurements were performed.

The scene log emitted a D-Bus assertion but the test and unit completed successfully. Source dc19d8tl used a literal wildcard; build nguub7yp had concurrent protected-file edits; reader 956pll94 had an incorrect four-byte expectation corrected to six. Their diagnostics remain retained.
